responseText: There's nothing quite like fresh shipments--fine silks, rare spices, and strange curiosities from far off lands--they keep our streets alive and bustling. If you're looking to put that weapon to use, why not lend a hand at the caravansary? Our economy depends on the safe passage of our caravans to and from the marketplace.
